description: Stage replacement discards the feature declaration before its delimiter restriction is checked (engine §13).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.value.split($E) = ∅
%const $E ""
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A
%redefine-stage second
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
```
